findings: Five sampled answers use named governmental medical sources with dated evidence; no drug doses or local rescue guarantees. Provisional acceptance subject to final independent medical-safety review.
hypothermia_first_response should offer a warm drink only if fully alert and able to swallow; consciousness alone is not sufficient if confused or drowsy.

Lost-person advice, acclimatization, older adults, dehydration response and basic injury response remain coverage gaps. Generic official medical/wilderness guidance can support non-local advice without claiming park-specific protocols; avoid treating missing local protocol as a reason to omit all general safety guidance.
